events.address: The Bowery Hotel, 335 Bowery, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A one-night NYFW beauty pop-up at The Bowery Hotel with personalized hair touch-ups, custom cocktails and photo moments, hosted by Hearst and Sephora.
events.what_is_free: Public admission is offered through RSVP; hair touch-ups, event experiences and custom cocktails are advertised for attendees. No paid ticket price is published in the verified event sources.
events.caveats: Fashionista lists Hair Haven as open to the public and links directly to a live RSVPify registration page. The verified public sources do not publish a paid ticket price or organizer-approval requirement. RSVP is therefore treated as the advertised access path rather than walk-in entry.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14 from 5–8 PM at The Bowery Hotel, 335 Bowery. Register through the live Hair Haven RSVPify page before traveling.

events.what_it_is: A free immersive bodega-themed pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats, with TEMPTATIONS treat sampling, games, prizes and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Free TEMPTATIONS cat treats are available to sample and take home. Guests can also play claw-machine and scratch-off games for chances to win Cat Bodega merchandise.
events.caveats: Mars/TEMPTATIONS describes the physical pop-up as free and publishes no RSVP requirement. Treats and merchandise prizes are promotional inventory; game prizes are not guaranteed to every visitor.
events.practical_notes: Thursday–Saturday, September 17–19, from 12–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery. Walk-in public activation; no purchase necessary.

occurrences.details: Free public RSVP through the live Hair Haven RSVPify page; no organizer-approval language published.
